versions.name: Wait for SSH host (reboot / rebuild)
versions.description: Block until an SSH server answers on the target host — wait out a reboot or cloud-init before the next deploy step. Runs from the runner host.
versions.description_zh: 等待目标主机 SSH 可登录（重启/重装后），再继续后续部署步骤。利用 Runner 出站网络，无需目标机暴露额外端口。
versions.author: buz maintainers
